title: The Morning Digest: October 4, 2026
dek: G7 leaders agreed Friday to a coordinated IEA release of up to 100 million barrels over four months, with diesel front-loaded into the first 20 days; WTI settled $91.11 (-1.9%) and Dec Brent $102.25 (essentially flat) as Friday's panic unwound into the close. TMW Nov26 held -$24.13 (ICE, Oct 2) with December at -$24.65 the widest tenor; the diesel crack closed at $97.94, ending eighteen straight closes above $100. UKMTO reports a tanker struck Sunday with engine-room damage, the third straight day of strikes. OPEC+ meets today; a roll is the consensus.

sources.publisher: G7 leaders' statement on energy security, via AP/WAVE
